ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution across the visible fluke surface with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at the distal tips; approximate ratio of 0.95:0.05 dark to light.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity pigment across the medial and lateral surfaces; high-contrast white contiguous blobs are located at the terminal distal coordinates of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 75 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entirety of the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits more irregular, deeper pixel-amplitude valleys near the outer third of the span compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward concave sweep originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, roughly circular clusters of high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle colonization or terminal scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily tattered and irregularly shaped distal tips on both lobes, with more pronounced material loss/irregularity on the terminal edge of the right lobe.
